note: REQ-128 L1 — the API token's default lifetime is 7 days; an empty / garbage / <= 0 override falls back to it. M1 the default back to 12 h · M2 the env override ignored · M3 the default is 7 hours (unit slip) · M4 the override read as minutes · M5 the guard dropped (an EMPTY line ⇒ 0 ⇒ every token expires at once) · M6 `> 0` → `>= 0` (a '0' override accepted).

mutations.what: 🔴 the env override ignored — the default always wins
the default is 7 hours (a unit slip: 7 * 3600)
the override is read as minutes, not seconds
🔴 the guard dropped: only an UNSET env falls back, so an EMPTY line gives 0 and every token expires the moment it is issued
the boundary: `> 0` becomes `>= 0`, so a '0' override is accepted
